//KeyVault: Source of ConnectionStrings:* and DenialWorkflowAuth:*. Secret names replace ':' with '--'. Blank the Uri in appsettings.Local.json to run entirely on local secrets.
//ReimbursementAgent: Reimbursement Insights chat (/ReimbursementChat). BaseUrl is the ReimbursementAgentProxy App
Service that fronts the Foundry ReimbursementAnalyst agent — this app relays questions to it
server-side, so the browser never calls it cross-origin and the CSP needs no exception.
TimeoutSeconds covers a whole agent run (reason + query the MCP bridge + write the breakdown).
RateLimit is per signed-in user: the proxy's own limit is per calling IP and every question
now arrives from this one server, so per-person fairness has to be enforced here.
Set Enabled to false to hide the chat without removing the menu entry.
//ChatToken: Signs the short-lived ticket that proves to the agent proxy that a signed-in user asked the
question. SigningKey is a SECRET and is deliberately absent here — it comes from Key Vault
(secret name ChatToken--SigningKey) or appsettings.Local.json, and must be byte-identical to
the ChatToken__SigningKey application setting on the reimb-agent-proxy App Service.
Issuer and Audience must match ChatToken__Issuer and ChatToken__Audience on that App Service.

Analytics.//SharedReportLab: Queue lab for cross-lab background exports (CPT & Panel Lookup). Read from {LabConfig:LabConfigFolder}\<name>.json and deliberately NOT listed in LabConfig:Labs, which drives the lab pickers. Its DbConnectionString must point at LRNMaster.

//ReportAvailability: Which labs each report on the Report Control Board is offered to. A report listed here is
governed ENTIRELY by its rule; a report NOT listed here keeps the built-in behaviour (the
report's own lab list plus the lab's EnableXxx flag in its lab config file).
Enabled     : false locks the report for every lab (pause / retire it).
Labs        : the only labs that get it. Empty or missing = every lab.
ExcludeLabs : locked out even if Labs would allow them. Applied first.
Note        : optional sentence shown in the padlock's tooltip.
Lab names match the keys under LabConfig.Labs, ignoring case, spaces and a trailing LRN/DTR.
Locked cells show a padlock on the board - never a failure. Edits apply on the next page
//ReportBoard: Per-lab settings for the Report Control Board. Lab names are matched against the keys under
LabConfig.Labs, ignoring case, spaces and a trailing LRN/DTR - so "Cove", "CoveLRN" and
LabOrder               : the order labs appear in the board's default 'Board order' view.
POSITION IN THIS LIST IS THE ORDER - to move a lab, move its line.
Labs not listed fall to the end, A-Z. The Latest and A-Z sort
NoMissingReportWarning : labs that never raise the 'not generated' warning - no banner
entry, no Overdue count, no row badge. For labs that are still
live on the board but have stopped billing, so having no recent
reports is expected rather than stalled. The lab and its real cell
statuses stay fully visible; stale cells show a gear, not a warning.
Edits apply on the next page load; no restart needed.
